items.title: MemState – Transactional, type-safe memory for AI agents (SQLite/Redis)
items.raw_excerpt: I wanted to share MemState, an open-source library I've been building for strict agent state management. It acts as a Git-like layer for Python agents: unlike standard vector memory, it enforces Pydantic schemas and supports transactional rollbacks (Time Travel) to prevent state corruption. Key technical features: * Strict Schemas: Uses Pydantic to validate memory on write. If an LLM tries to save a string into an int field, the transaction fails before corruption happens. * Time Travel: Every change is an append-only transaction. You can call memory.rollback(1) to undo an agent's hallucination. * Constraints: Enforce logic like Singleton facts (e.g., only one "User Profile" per session). * No Vectors required: It uses SQLite's JSON1 extension for structured filtering, which is faster and

items.title: Nerve – The AI Chief of Staff that does your actual work
items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN, Tanooj and Aziz here from Nerve. We’re building a work AI that handles full end to end workflows rather than just chat replies. It starts with proactively figuring out what’s important to you - anything you need to take action on or updates on any projects - and then moves all the way through the process. Nerve gathers the relevant information, drafts documents, writes jira tickets, sends emails, etc. What this looks like in practice is: say an account executive has a sales call that gets recorded into Gong, Nerve automatically picks up the call, and extracts the next steps. items.title: Reverse engineering a $1B Legal AI tool exposed 100k+ confidential files
items.raw_excerpt: Reverse engineering of the $1B legal AI tool Filevine exposed over 100,000 confidential files due to API vulnerabilities, highlighting significant data security risks in AI-powered legal platforms.

title_i18n.zh: 逆向工程一款价值10亿美元的法律人工智能工具，暴露了超过10万份机密文件。
title_i18n.es: La ingeniería inversa de una herramienta de IA legal de 1.000 millones de dólares expuso más de 100.000 archivos confidenciales

excerpt_i18n.en: Reverse engineering of the $1B legal AI tool Filevine exposed over 100,000 confidential files due to API vulnerabilities, highlighting significant data security risks in AI-powered legal platforms.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 一项针对价值10亿美元的法律AI工具Filevine的反向工程分析，意外暴露了超过10万份机密文件。安全研究人员发现该平台的API存在漏洞，导致敏感法律文档可被公开访问。这一事件凸显了AI工具在数据安全方面面临的严峻挑战。
